display.purpose: Call clock and call phase only.

title.purpose: Page titles, sheet titles, and screen-state titles.

strong.purpose: Names, row titles, and button labels.

caption.purpose: Secondary lines, dock labels, and status pills.

shadows.name: dock-drop
shadows.purpose: The floating tab bar on graphite. On paper the shadow color is rgba(23,25,29,0.16) at the same offset, opacity 0.28, and radius.

shadows.name: sedan-contact
shadows.purpose: Fixed ground shadow under the sedan. It does not rotate with heading and is not a box shadow.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Button press. Icon buttons and SOS scale to 0.96. Disabled controls stay at opacity 0.4.

motion.name: score-ring
motion.purpose: Safety ring progress. Duration is 0 when reduced motion is on.

motion.name: sheet-enter
motion.purpose: Live telemetry card entrance. Skipped when reduced motion is on.

motion.name: sos-pulse
motion.value: 1400ms scale 1 to 1.16, reverse, opacity 2 minus scale
motion.purpose: SOS ring pulse. Omitted when reduced motion is on.

motion.name: map-follow
motion.purpose: Camera follow toward the vehicle. Duration is 0 when reduced motion is on.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The lime instrument action. Manrope 600 at 15px, lime ink on lime.
components.css: .ds-btn-lime { background: #D7F76B; color: #1A1E0C; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-lime:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-lime:active { opacity: 0.82; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-lime:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5F6F7; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-lime:disabled { opacity: 0.4; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A secondary action with a strong hairline and no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #F5F6F7; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 16px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { opacity: 0.82; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D7F76B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive action. White label on danger.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: #FF453A; color: #FFFFFF; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 16px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-btn-danger:active { opacity: 0.82; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5F6F7; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: A 48px glass circle for map tools. The mark is an 18px line icon.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Recenter on vehicle"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="2" x2="5" y1="12" y2="12"/><line x1="19" x2="22" y1="12" y2="12"/><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="2" y2="5"/><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="19" y2="22"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="7"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); background: rgba(16,18,22,0.78); color: #F5F6F7; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-icon-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-icon-btn:active { opacity: 0.82; transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D7F76B; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A 48px raised field with a hairline. Placeholder is faint steel.
components.css: .ds-field { height: 48px; width: 100%; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); background: #14171C; color: #F5F6F7; padding: 0 14px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #8B929C; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D7F76B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Floating telemetry. Blur stands in for BlurView intensity 36, with the glass fill and tint.
components.css: .ds-glass { border-radius: 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); background: rgba(16,18,22,0.78); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1000px rgba(9,10,12,0.42); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); padding: 14px 16px; width: 240px; } .ds-glass-label { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.1px; color: #8B929C; } .ds-glass-metric { font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -0.6px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #F5F6F7; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Dock
components.description: The floating five-tab bar. The active tab is lime with lime ink.
components.css: .ds-dock { height: 62px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 26px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); background: rgba(16,18,22,0.78); box-shadow: 0 10px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.28), inset 0 0 0 1000px rgba(9,10,12,0.42); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); } .ds-dock-tab { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 18px; background: transparent; color: #A1A6AF; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 11px; } .ds-dock-tab svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-dock-tab-on { background: #D7F76B; color: #1A1E0C; } .ds-dock-tab:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-dock-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D7F76B; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dock-badge { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 16px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #FF453A; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Safe, caution, or emergency, with a 6px dot and a caption in the status color.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; background: #1C2128; color: #D7F76B; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-pill i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 3px; background: #D7F76B; display: block; }

components.name: SOS
components.description: A 52px danger circle. The pulse scales from 1 to 1.16 over 1400ms.
components.css: .ds-sos { position: relative; width: 52px; height: 52px; border: none; border-radius: 26px; background: #FF453A; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; } .ds-sos::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 26px; background: #FF453A; animation: ds-sos-pulse 1400ms ease-in-out infinite alternate; z-index: -1; } .ds-sos:hover { opacity: 0.92; } .ds-sos:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-sos:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5F6F7; outline-offset: 3px; } @keyframes ds-sos-pulse { from { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } to { transform: scale(1.16); opacity: 0.84; } }

components.name: Sedan Marker
components.description: The pearl top-down sedan. Shown at 72px. The ground ellipse stays fixed while the body rotates with heading.

narrative.overview:
VMS is a quiet automotive instrument for one live ride. The vehicle is a pearl top-down sedan on a muted map, and the chrome around it is either graphite or cool gray, with lime reserved for selected, occupied, safe, and primary states. Dark graphite is the boot palette and the default until a saved appearance is read. Light is the same structure on cool paper, with darker signal, amber, danger, and cyan so status stays readable. Sora carries titles and metrics. Manrope carries everything a person reads or taps.

Depth is tonal. Page groups, sheets, and the SOS confirmation are opaque raised fills with a hairline. Blurred glass is limited to chrome that floats: the live identity, the alert popover, the telemetry card, the dock, and call permission panels. Presses scale down and fire a selection haptic. The safety ring eases over 700ms, the telemetry card fades up over 480ms, and the SOS ring pulses over 1400ms. All three yield when the platform asks for reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite dark and cool-gray light, with lime as the instrument accent
Sora for titles and metrics, Manrope for UI
Blurred glass only on floating chrome, the dock, and call panels
Pearl top-down sedan marker with a fixed ground shadow
Circular controls and a floating five-tab dock

rules.name: The Lime Instrument Rule
rules.body: Lime marks a selected, occupied, safe, or primary state. It is the primary button, the active dock tab, an occupied seat, an attentive cabin pill, a switch that is on, and the sedan's rear lamp. On graphite the live dot and the safe signal are the same lime. On paper, status strokes use signal-on-paper. Lime is not a page or map background.

rules.name: The Paired Semantic Rule
rules.body: Amber, danger, danger-soft, and cyan each have a graphite value and a darker paper value. Render the pair that matches the active scheme. The light theme is a full palette, not the dark palette with a white background.

rules.name: The Two Faces Rule
rules.body: Sora is for titles and metrics. Manrope is for body, labels, captions, and controls. Do not set a metric in Manrope or a button in Sora.

rules.name: The Two Planes Rule
rules.body: The live ride is the map, with floating chrome inset 16px. Every other screen is a filled page with a 20px side inset, a Sora title, and a scroll that clears the dock.

rules.name: The Glass Ceiling Rule
rules.body: The blurred glass shell is the live identity pill, the alert popover, the telemetry card, the dock, and call permission panels. Page groups, the vehicle sheet, and the SOS confirmation stay opaque raised fills with a hairline.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: When the platform reports reduced motion, the SOS pulse is omitted, the safety ring snaps to its value, the telemetry card does not fade in, and map follow animation duration is 0.

rules.name: The Circle Control Rule
rules.body: A tappable icon on the map, in the page header, or on a call is a 48px circle. SOS is the 52px exception. Rectangular buttons stay on the 16px radius and at least 48px tall. Segment cells and screen-state actions stay at least 44px tall.

dos: Do boot on graphite, and treat light as a full cool-gray palette with its own signal, amber, danger, danger-soft, and cyan.
Do keep primary buttons at 48px height, 16px radius, lime fill, and lime-ink labels in Manrope 600 at 15px.
Do float the dock, the live identity, and the telemetry card in blurred glass over the map.
Do draw the sedan at 72px inside an 84px target, with the ground shadow fixed and the body rotated to heading.
Do set metrics in Sora 500 with tabular figures, and body copy in Manrope 400 at 15px with 21px line height.
donts: Don't paint page cards, the vehicle sheet, or the SOS confirmation with blurred glass.
Don't use lime as a page or map background, or as a status stroke on the light theme.
Don't replace the pearl sedan with a pin, an emoji, or a photograph on the map.
Don't add a hard offset shadow. The dock's soft drop is the only box shadow.
Don't set a typeface other than Sora for titles and metrics, or other than Manrope for UI text.
